response.sql: WITH per_actor AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) FROM film_actor) AS share FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id) SELECT actor_id, film_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg FROM per_actor ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Films credited per actor is the count of film_actor rows for that actor_id (the primary key is (actor_id, film_id), so there are no duplicates). Actors with no film_actor rows are excluded, as the request is for actors in film_actor.
The average is taken over all actors present in film_actor (unweighted mean of the per-actor share), computed before the top-10 limit.
Ties in the difference are broken arbitrarily since no secondary sort is specified.
